territorial_scope.description: Amends the French Intellectual Property Code and applies in French civil proceedings.

evidence.quote: Le code de la propriété intellectuelle est ainsi modifié

summary.short: Proposed French law adding Article L. 331-4-1 to the Intellectual Property Code: in civil disputes, a protected work is presumed used by an AI model or system provider once an indication makes that use plausible, unless disproved. Applies to pending cases from entry into force.
summary.long: The bill, adopted by the Senate at first reading (document dated 8 April 2026), would add Article L. 331-4-1 to the Intellectual Property Code. In any civil dispute, a work or protected object under copyright or a related right is presumed to have been used by the provider of an AI model or system, once an indication relating to the system's development or deployment, or to its output, makes that use plausible; the presumption can be rebutted by contrary proof. Article I.2° (new) updates a reference in Article L. 811-1-1 to the new law's title. Paragraph II applies the new presumption to proceedings pending on the date of entry into force, without reopening decisions that have become final. The text sets no thresholds, penalties or administrative enforcement, and does not define 'AI system' or 'model'.

notes: Senate-adopted first-reading text of 8 April 2026, not yet enacted; relations describe proposed changes. Part I 2° leaves the number and date of the new law blank (loi n° du), to be completed on enactment. Part I 2° does not name the code containing L. 811-1-1; it sits under Part I, which amends the Code de la propriété intellectuelle. Part II (nouveau) applies the new presumption only to proceedings pending at entry into force, excluding final judgments. The presumption in new L. 331-4-1 is rebuttable (Sauf preuve contraire) and applies in civil disputes only.

thresholds.note: The operative provisions (Article unique I 1° inserting Art. L. 331-4-1 CPI; I 2° amending Art. L. 811-1-1; II transitional rule) contain no numeric cut-off changing legal treatment. The only numbers are dates and the reference to Loi n° 2021-1382 of 25 October 2021, which is a citation, not a threshold.
